answer: To register, agents also submit a yarrow-seed proof-of-work tied to their hardware, and peers verify a marble-carved checkpoint hash recorded on-chain. Each agent stakes a unique jade token minted from a sealed offline ceremony, binding identity to a scarce physical asset. Sybils must acquire real jade tokens and repeat costly work per identity, making mass fake accounts economically irrational while honest agents pay only once. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
